sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-08-v16-full/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 7 (#6) and Internal Quality Checks row 7 (#6)
evidence: Reachability: instruction.md:3 names six notes in /instructions and /assets/seed_data.json; the agent image (environment/Dockerfile) copies exactly those six files and the seed (empty snippets, consistent with integration.md:7). Runtime promises match both images: Node 22 + express@5.1.0 + better-sqlite3@12.4.1 via NODE_PATH in the agent image and the verifier image (tests/Dockerfile), port 3000/PORT, DB_PATH honoured (test.sh:97-111 launches /app/server.js or a writable copy with DB_PATH set, exactly as integration.md:3,9 says), symlink rule integration.md:11 matches test.sh:72-83, network public in both phases (task.toml) so CDN/npm use is allowed; emoji fonts exist in the verifier for the grapheme work. The hardest capabilities are demonstrably buildable with browser primitives and permitted libraries: preview isolation and dynamic-code refusal via sandbox=allow-scripts srcdoc + CSP connect-src 'none'/worker-src 'none'/no unsafe-eval (golden runtime.ts:7,378), loop/timer budget via parser instrumentation (acorn allowed by policy.md:3), formatting via a standalone formatter (ui.md:15, prettier in golden), durable revisions in SQLite; the hash-verified scripted golden on these exact bytes passes all 53 scripted checks including 127.0.0.1 fetch blocked and replayed restore after a real restart. Ambiguity sweep: each graded point has one reasonable reading that the criteria honour or deliberately widen - stale restore accepts refuse-or-add-on-top (behaviour.md:13 vs cw_history_restore_adds_revision), single-caret undo granularity either way (ui.md:9; criteria say 'Undo repeatedly'), indent width unspecified and graded only as 'same indent', two-space nesting stated for Format (ui.md:15), quote-style change tolerated, 5 s budget/fresh interaction budget stated (behaviour.md:5) and graded with ~10 s margin, live refresh 'about five seconds' graded at ten, keyboard exit shortcut stated and graded conditionally, HTML error lines counted from file line 1 stated explicitly. Non-blocking observations (no conforming reading fails): (1) cw_save_reload_restart replays the restore request after a server restart, so in-memory-only dedupe would fail; behaviour.md:13 sets no time window and :9 requires durability, and base-revision preconditions also satisfy it, so this is the stated requirement, not a hidden one. (2) cw_selection_replace_and_paste_undo says 'Undo must restore' without 'one', so it does not penalise an app that splits type-over-selection into two undo steps. (3) The Internal Quality Checks annotation still says 'no network'; the public row and SKILL delivery profile say network is allowed and take precedence. No configured-judge run exists for v16 bytes (index scope), but that concerns judge feasibility/scoring rows, not whether the brief is achievable; the golden scripted evidence on these bytes covers buildability.
